d: Ramayana has finally given audiences a glimpse of its grand cinematic world! With stunning VFX, impressive performances and powerful music, does this ambitious adaptation live up to the expectations? In this episode of Samosa Critics, we (Abhishek Manchanda, Prashant Kapoor) react to Ramayana, discuss Yash and Ranbir Kapoor's performances, admire the visual effects and explore the film's music, presentation and overall cinematic experience. Are the visuals and performances enough to make Ramayana a landmark film? What impressed us the most, and what could have been better? Watch our full…
